{{Top}}
'''Har Gau''' was a city situated on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], established by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] settlers there. It was home to the many water stations that a toxin was spreading to. [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] attempted to stop the poison from spreading there. With the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] deaths, the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] finished the job of stopping the poisons' spread.
